Maintenance control wants the grounding risk scorer back. A migration stripped five modules
out of `src/fleetrisk/` and never restored them, so every function in those five raises
`NotImplementedError` and nothing runs.

Rebuild them. The service has to reproduce its last accepted run to the last decimal, on
both of the scheduled configurations:

    python3 run_scoring.py --config configs/reference.yaml --out out/reference
    python3 run_scoring.py --config configs/current.yaml   --out out/current

`configs/reference.yaml` is the accepted backtest and the only one you can check yourself
against. What it produced before the migration is in `reference/`: the score for every
flight it touched, and the summary the run wrote beside them. `tools/compare_scores.py`
diffs a pair of score files.

`configs/current.yaml` runs the live scoring period off the same history. It scores flying
from well after the end of that history, and nothing is published for it, so nothing will
tell you whether you have that one right.

`SPEC.md` is the contract the desk signed off. It describes every published quantity in the
terms operations uses and deliberately carries no formulas, so where a definition could go
more than one way, the published run decides it.

The other modules, the configs and the export are not part of the job. Leave them alone.

# Fleet grounding risk: specification

This says what the service is for and what each published quantity means. It is written
the way the operations desk describes its own model, in business terms.

**It gives no formulas.** Where a definition could reasonably be written more than one way,
the published backtest settles it: `reference/scores_reference.csv` is what the service
produced on that run and `reference/run_report.json` is the summary it wrote beside it. A
correct rebuild reproduces both.

---

## 1. Run shape

A run reads the export, fits on the **fit window** and scores the **score window**, both
named in the run configuration and inclusive of the last second of their end date.

Flights are processed in `flight_id` order. Everything the service knows about an aircraft,
a station, a route or an operator is learned from the **fit window only**.

## 2. What the service is predicting

A flight is **at risk** if the aircraft that flew it is grounded within
`labelling.window_days` days of leaving. Groundings are exported separately, in
`data/groundings.csv.gz`; they are not in the flight log, because a grounded flight never
operated.

## 3. What the service fits on

The service does not fit on every flight in the fit window.

A flight is only usable for fitting if its outcome is already settled by the history the
service is allowed to read. Which flights that leaves out, and on what grounds, is part of
the rebuild.

## 4. What the features mean

Thirty-eight quantities are published, in the order `src/fleetrisk/assemble.py` declares them.

**Departure.** When the flight was scheduled out: hour, day of week, month, week of year,
whether it fell at a weekend, and how far into the exported period it sits.

**The leg.** What the flight looks like on paper and how it actually ran: distance, block
time, taxi out, departure and arrival delay, whether it was diverted, and the average speed
its block time implies.

**The aircraft on paper.** From the fleet register: which operator it belongs to, whether it
left from its home station, and how many aircraft that operator runs.

**The stations.** From the station reference: the state at each end and whether both ends
sit in the same state.

**Aircraft record.** What the fit window knows about the airframe: how much it flew, how
often it was grounded, how often that was per flight, how long since the last grounding,
how long it has been in the exported fleet, and its usual departure delay.

**Station record.** The same idea for the airports at each end: how much flew from there and
how often aircraft based there were grounded.

**Reliability.** How often flights of this operator, this route and this departure station
turned out to be at risk. A rate over thin history is unreliable, so it is pulled toward the
fleet rate in proportion to how little history stands behind it; `encoding.smoothing` sets
how hard.

**Recent form.** How the aircraft has been behaving lately rather than over the whole
window: its grounding rate over the last fortnight, how long since it last flew, and its
departure delay over its last `recent.flights` legs.

**Against the fleet.** How the aircraft, its departure station and its operator sit against
the fleet rate.

## 5. Rows with no history behind them

Plenty of airframes go the whole fit window without being grounded once. Their "how long
since the last grounding" is not a large number and it is not zero; there is no such date to
measure from. The service marks those with **-1** rather than inventing a gap.

A live run also carries legs the fit window has nothing at all on: an airframe that joined
after the history ends, a station or a route that never appears in it. Those legs are still
scored. Wherever a quantity is a rate, an average or a span taken over history the leg does
not have, the service puts the fleet-wide level for that quantity in its place, so the leg
sits at the fleet average rather than at zero. Counts are the exception. An aircraft the
history has never seen has flown no flights and been grounded no times, and those are
recorded as such. Time since the last grounding follows the paragraph above.

## 6. Model

Gradient boosting over the thirty-eight features, fitted on the fit window against the label, using
`model.seed`, `model.max_iter`, `model.learning_rate` and `model.max_depth`. Values that are
not finite are treated as zero before fitting.

## 7. Output

One row per scored flight, in `flight_id` order, carrying `flight_id`, `tail_number`,
`departed_at`, `risk_score` and `watch`.

`risk_score` is the modelled probability that the flight is at risk, rounded to six decimal
places. `watch` is 1 when the unrounded score is at least `scoring.watch_threshold`.

A run also writes a summary beside the scores. The summary is not graded.

# Fleet grounding risk service

Maintenance control runs this against the overnight operations export. It puts a number on
every leg that flew: how likely is it that this airframe gets grounded in the next few days.
Anything over the watch threshold gets pulled forward for a check before it strands a crew.

    python3 run_scoring.py --config configs/reference.yaml --out out/reference

## Layout

    run_scoring.py        nightly entry point
    SPEC.md               what the service computes, and what each quantity means
    configs/              run configuration, one file per scheduled run
    data/                 the overnight export
    src/fleetrisk/        the service
    reference/            the published output from the accepted backtest
    tools/                helper for comparing two runs

## The export

Two feeds, and they do not overlap.

`data/flights.csv.gz` is the flight log: one row per leg that actually operated, with the
schedule, the delays and the airframe that flew it.

`data/groundings.csv.gz` comes off the ops system instead. It records cancellations, with
the tail number and the time. A cancelled leg never operated, so it is not in the flight log
at all, and the two feeds have to be matched up before you can say which flights turned out
badly.

`data/fleet.csv` is the airframe register and `data/stations.csv` the airport reference.
Both are slow moving.

The export is a rolling pull. It starts at a fixed date and stops on whichever day it was
taken, which is worth keeping in mind when reading anything derived from it.

Airframes join and leave the fleet and stations come and go, so a live run will always
carry legs whose aircraft or departure station the history has never seen. `SPEC.md` says
what the desk does with those.

## The two scheduled runs

The backtest, `configs/reference.yaml`, is the one that has been signed off. What it
produced last time is under `reference/`: the scores themselves and the run summary.

The live run, `configs/current.yaml`, fits on the same history and scores a stretch of flying
from well after the end of it. Nothing is published for it, so the only run you can check
yourself is the backtest.
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Nightly entry point.

    python3 run_scoring.py --config configs/reference.yaml --out out/
"""
import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "src"))

from fleetrisk import config, pipeline, report, validate


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--config", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    cfg = config.load(args.config)
    out_dir = Path(args.out)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    scores, fit_df, score_df = pipeline.run(cfg)
    validate.check(scores)

    scores.to_csv(out_dir / "scores.csv", index=False)
    report.write(out_dir / "run_report.json",
                 report.summarise(scores, cfg))
    print("scored %d rows, watching %d" % (len(scores), int(scores["watch"].sum())))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Fleet grounding risk scoring service."""
"""Fits on the fit window and scores the window the run config names."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from . import (assemble, calendar_feats, deviations, fleet_profile, io_layer,
               model, observation, portfolio, recent, reliability, route_feats,
               station_history, station_profile, tail_history)


def _window(df, spec):
    lo = pd.Timestamp(spec["from"])
    hi = pd.Timestamp(spec["to"]) + pd.Timedelta(days=1) - pd.Timedelta(seconds=1)
    return df[(df["departed_at"] >= lo) & (df["departed_at"] <= hi)]


def build(cfg):
    flights = io_layer.read_flights(cfg)
    groundings = io_layer.read_groundings(cfg)
    fleet = io_layer.read_fleet(cfg)
    stations = io_layer.read_stations(cfg)

    window_days = cfg["labelling"]["window_days"]
    export_end = flights["departed_at"].max()
    period_start = flights["departed_at"].min()

    labelled = observation.attach_label(flights, groundings, window_days)
    labelled = labelled.sort_values("flight_id", kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)

    fit_raw = _window(labelled, cfg["windows"]["fit"])
    fit_raw = fit_raw[observation.observed(fit_raw, cfg["windows"]["fit"],
                                          export_end, window_days)]
    fit_raw = fit_raw.reset_index(drop=True)
    score_raw = _window(labelled, cfg["windows"]["score"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    fit_end = fit_raw["departed_at"].max()
    levels = portfolio.levels(fit_raw, groundings, fit_end)
    hist = tail_history.history(fit_raw, groundings, fit_end)

    def prepare(frame):
        out = calendar_feats.add(frame, period_start)
        out = route_feats.add(out)
        out = fleet_profile.add(out, fleet)
        out = station_profile.add(out, stations)
        out = tail_history.add(out, hist, levels)
        out = station_history.add(out, fit_raw, groundings, fleet, fit_end, levels)
        out = recent.add(out, fit_raw, groundings, fit_end, levels)
        return out

    fit_df = prepare(fit_raw)
    score_df = prepare(score_raw)

    smoothing = cfg["encoding"]["smoothing"]
    base = levels["rate"]
    operator_rates = reliability.rate_table(fit_df, "operator", smoothing, base)
    fit_df = fit_df.assign(_route=reliability.route_key(fit_df))
    score_df = score_df.assign(_route=reliability.route_key(score_df))
    route_rates = reliability.rate_table(fit_df, "_route", smoothing, base)
    station_rates = reliability.rate_table(fit_df, "origin", smoothing, base)

    fit_df = reliability.add(fit_df, operator_rates, route_rates, station_rates)
    score_df = reliability.add(score_df, operator_rates, route_rates, station_rates)
    fit_df = deviations.add(fit_df, levels)
    score_df = deviations.add(score_df, levels)
    return fit_df.drop(columns=["_route"]), score_df.drop(columns=["_route"])


def run(cfg):
    fit_df, score_df = build(cfg)

    mdl = model.RiskModel(cfg["model"]["seed"], cfg["model"]["max_iter"],
                          cfg["model"]["learning_rate"], cfg["model"]["max_depth"])
    mdl.fit(assemble.matrix(fit_df), fit_df["label"].astype("int64").to_numpy())

    risk = mdl.score(assemble.matrix(score_df))
    threshold = float(cfg["scoring"]["watch_threshold"])
    out = pd.DataFrame({
        "flight_id": score_df["flight_id"].astype(str).to_numpy(),
        "tail_number": score_df["tail_number"].astype(str).to_numpy(),
        "departed_at": score_df["departed_at"].to_numpy(),
        "risk_score": np.round(risk, 6),
        "watch": (risk >= threshold).astype("int64"),
    })
    return out, fit_df, score_df

"""Design matrix assembly."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

try:
    from .schema import FEATURES
except ImportError:
    from schema import FEATURES


def matrix(df):
    """The published features, in the declared order, as a float matrix."""
    missing = [name for name in FEATURES if name not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise KeyError("design matrix is missing %s" % ", ".join(missing))
    return df[list(FEATURES)].astype("float64").to_numpy()
=== calendar_feats.py ===
"""When the flight was scheduled to leave."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def add(df, period_start):
    out = df.copy()
    when = out["departed_at"]
    out["f_hour"] = when.dt.hour.astype("float64")
    out["f_dow"] = when.dt.dayofweek.astype("float64")
    out["f_month"] = when.dt.month.astype("float64")
    out["f_week"] = when.dt.isocalendar().week.astype("float64").to_numpy()
    out["f_is_weekend"] = (when.dt.dayofweek >= 5).astype("float64")
    out["f_days_into_period"] = (when - period_start).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    return out
=== config.py ===
"""Run configuration."""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict

import yaml

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

DEFAULTS: Dict[str, Any] = {
    "paths": {"data_dir": "data"},
    "labelling": {"window_days": 3},
    "encoding": {"smoothing": 50.0},
    "recent": {"flights": 20},
    "model": {"seed": 5, "max_iter": 200, "learning_rate": 0.08, "max_depth": 6},
    "scoring": {"watch_threshold": 0.25},
}


class ConfigError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when the run configuration cannot be used as written."""


def _merge(base: Dict[str, Any], override: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    out = copy.deepcopy(base)
    for key, value in (override or {}).items():
        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(out.get(key), dict):
            out[key] = _merge(out[key], value)
        else:
            out[key] = value
    return out


def load(path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    raw = yaml.safe_load(Path(path).read_text()) or {}
    cfg = _merge(DEFAULTS, raw)
    for section in ("windows",):
        if section not in cfg:
            raise ConfigError("config is missing the %s section" % section)
    return cfg


def data_path(name: str, cfg: Dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Path:
    base = Path((cfg or DEFAULTS)["paths"]["data_dir"])
    return base / name

"""What the register says about the aircraft flying this leg."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def add(df, fleet):
    reg = fleet.set_index("tail_number")
    operators = sorted(fleet["operator"].dropna().unique())
    codes = {name: float(i) for i, name in enumerate(operators)}
    sizes = fleet.groupby("operator")["tail_number"].nunique()

    out = df.copy()
    home = out["tail_number"].map(reg["home_station"])
    carrier = out["tail_number"].map(reg["operator"]).fillna(out["operator"])
    out["f_operator"] = carrier.map(codes).fillna(-1.0).astype("float64")
    out["f_from_home"] = (out["origin"] == home).astype("float64")
    out["f_fleet_size"] = carrier.map(sizes).fillna(0.0).astype("float64")
    return out

"""Estimator."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Tuple

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier


class RiskModel(object):

    def __init__(self, seed, max_iter, learning_rate, max_depth):
        self.seed = int(seed)
        self.max_iter = int(max_iter)
        self.learning_rate = float(learning_rate)
        self.max_depth = int(max_depth)
        self.clf_ = None

    def fit(self, X, y):
        """Values that are not finite are carried as zero."""
        self.clf_ = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
            max_iter=self.max_iter, learning_rate=self.learning_rate,
            max_depth=self.max_depth, random_state=self.seed,
            early_stopping=False)
        self.clf_.fit(np.nan_to_num(X, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0), y)
        return self

    def score(self, X):
        return self.clf_.predict_proba(
            np.nan_to_num(X, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0))[:, 1]

"""Fleet-wide levels, used wherever a row has no history of its own."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def levels(fit_flights, groundings, fit_end):
    """One fallback number per quantity, taken over the whole fit window."""
    seen = groundings[groundings["occurred_at"] <= pd.Timestamp(fit_end)]
    per_tail = fit_flights.groupby("tail_number").agg(
        flights=("flight_id", "size"), first_seen=("departed_at", "min"),
        last_seen=("departed_at", "max"))
    tenure = (pd.Timestamp(fit_end) - per_tail["first_seen"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    gap = (pd.Timestamp(fit_end) - per_tail["last_seen"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    return {
        "rate": float(len(seen)) / max(float(len(fit_flights)), 1.0),
        "tenure": float(tenure.mean()),
        "gap": float(gap.mean()),
        "dep_delay": float(pd.to_numeric(fit_flights["departure_delay"],
                                         errors="coerce").mean()),
    }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Diff two score files by flight_id.

    python3 tools/compare_scores.py a/scores.csv b/scores.csv
"""
import argparse

import pandas as pd

TOLERANCE = 1e-6


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("left")
    ap.add_argument("right")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    left = pd.read_csv(args.left)
    right = pd.read_csv(args.right)
    merged = left[["flight_id", "risk_score"]].merge(
        right[["flight_id", "risk_score"]], on="flight_id", how="outer",
        suffixes=("_left", "_right"))
    diff = (merged["risk_score_left"] - merged["risk_score_right"]).abs()
    same = (diff <= TOLERANCE).fillna(False)
    print("rows %d, agree %d (%.6f), max abs diff %.6g"
          % (len(merged), int(same.sum()), same.mean(), float(diff.max())))
    worst = merged.assign(diff=diff).sort_values("diff", ascending=False).head(10)
    print(worst.to_string(index=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def attach_label(flights, groundings, window_days):
    """Label each flight: 1 when its aircraft is grounded within the window."""
    out = flights.copy()
    window = pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)
    base = out[["tail_number", "departed_at"]].copy()
    base["_row"] = np.arange(len(base))
    merged = base.merge(groundings[["tail_number", "occurred_at"]],
                        on="tail_number", how="left")
    delta = merged["occurred_at"] - merged["departed_at"]
    hit = (delta >= pd.Timedelta(0)) & (delta <= window)
    label = np.zeros(len(out), dtype="int64")
    label[merged.loc[hit, "_row"].to_numpy()] = 1
    out["label"] = label
    return out


def observed(df, fit_spec, export_end, window_days):
    """Keep only flights whose outcome the export has already settled."""
    deadline = pd.Timestamp(export_end)
    return (df["departed_at"] + pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)) <= deadline

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def history(fit_flights, groundings, fit_end):
    """Per-airframe record of the fit window, measured as of its end."""
    end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end)
    per = fit_flights.groupby("tail_number").agg(
        flights=("flight_id", "size"),
        first_seen=("departed_at", "min"),
        dep_delay=("departure_delay", "mean"),
    )
    seen = groundings[groundings["occurred_at"] <= end]
    per["groundings"] = seen.groupby("tail_number").size().reindex(per.index).fillna(0.0)
    last_grounded = seen.groupby("tail_number")["occurred_at"].max()
    per["days_since_grounding"] = np.nan
    has = per.index.isin(last_grounded.index)
    per.loc[has, "days_since_grounding"] = (
        (end - last_grounded.reindex(per.index[has])).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0)
    per["rate"] = per["groundings"] / per["flights"]
    per["tenure"] = (end - per["first_seen"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    return per


def add(df, hist, portfolio):
    out = df.copy()
    tail = out["tail_number"]
    out["f_tail_prior_flights"] = tail.map(hist["flights"]).fillna(0.0).astype("float64")
    out["f_tail_prior_groundings"] = tail.map(hist["groundings"]).fillna(0.0).astype("float64")
    out["f_tail_grounding_rate"] = tail.map(hist["rate"]).fillna(
        float(portfolio["rate"])).astype("float64")
    out["f_tail_days_since_grounding"] = tail.map(hist["days_since_grounding"]).fillna(
        -1.0).astype("float64")
    out["f_tail_tenure_days"] = tail.map(hist["tenure"]).fillna(
        float(portfolio["tenure"])).astype("float64")
    out["f_tail_mean_dep_delay"] = tail.map(hist["dep_delay"]).fillna(
        float(portfolio["dep_delay"])).astype("float64")
    return out
"}

def add(df, fit_flights, groundings, fleet, fit_end, portfolio):

        _base=fit_flights["tail_number"].map(home)).groupby("_base")["flight_id"].size()

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

RECENT_FLIGHTS = 20
RECENT_DAYS = 14


def add(df, fit_flights, groundings, fit_end, portfolio):
    out = df.copy()
    end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end)
    since = end - pd.Timedelta(days=RECENT_DAYS)

    win_flights = fit_flights[(fit_flights["departed_at"] > since)
                              & (fit_flights["departed_at"] <= end)]
    win_groundings = groundings[(groundings["occurred_at"] > since)
                                & (groundings["occurred_at"] <= end)]

    counts = win_flights.groupby("tail_number")["flight_id"].size()
    grounded = win_groundings.groupby("tail_number").size()
    rate = (grounded / counts).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    last_flight = fit_flights.groupby("tail_number")["departed_at"].max()
    days_since = (end - last_flight).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    recent_delay = (win_flights.sort_values("departed_at", kind="stable")
                    .groupby("tail_number")["departure_delay"]
                    .apply(lambda s: s.tail(RECENT_FLIGHTS).mean()))

    tail = out["tail_number"]
    out["f_recent_grounding_rate"] = tail.map(rate).fillna(
        float(portfolio["rate"])).astype("float64")
    out["f_days_since_prev_flight"] = tail.map(days_since).fillna(
        float(portfolio["gap"])).astype("float64")
    out["f_recent_dep_delay"] = tail.map(recent_delay).fillna(
        float(portfolio["dep_delay"])).astype("float64")
    return out

{"content": """"Grounding rates by operator, by route and by station.

A rate over thin history says more about the thinness than about the risk, so each one
is pulled toward the portfolio rate in proportion to how little stands behind it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

CATCH_ALL = "__unseen__"


def rate_table(fit_df, key, smoothing, prior):
    """Smoothed at-risk rate per level of ``key`` pulled toward ``prior``."""
    grouped = fit_df.groupby(key)["label"].agg(["size", "sum"])
    smoothed = (grouped["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (grouped["size"] + smoothing)
    table = smoothed.astype("float64")
    table[CATCH_ALL] = float(prior)
    return table


def route_key(df):
    return df["origin"].astype(str) + "->" + df["destination"].astype(str)


def add(df, operator_rates, route_rates, station_rates):
    out = df.copy()
    out["f_operator_rate"] = out["operator"].map(operator_rates).fillna(
        operator_rates[CATCH_ALL]).astype("float64")
    out["f_route_rate"] = out["_route"].map(route_rates).fillna(
        route_rates[CATCH_ALL]).astype("float64")
    out["f_station_rate"] = out["origin"].map(station_rates).fillna(
        station_rates[CATCH_ALL]).astype("float64")
    return out

"""Labelling, and the subset of the export the desk fits on."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def attach_label(flights, groundings, window_days):
    """Label each flight: 1 when its aircraft is grounded within the window."""
    out = flights.copy()
    window = pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)
    base = out[["tail_number", "departed_at"]].copy()
    base["_row"] = np.arange(len(base))
    merged = base.merge(groundings[["tail_number", "occurred_at"]],
                        on="tail_number", how="left")
    delta = merged["occurred_at"] - merged["departed_at"]
    hit = (delta >= pd.Timedelta(0)) & (delta <= window)
    label = np.zeros(len(out), dtype="int64")
    label[merged.loc[hit, "_row"].to_numpy()] = 1
    out["label"] = label
    return out


def observed(df, fit_spec, export_end, window_days):
    """Keep flights whose outcome is settled inside what the run can read."""
    horizon = pd.Timestamp(fit_spec["to"]) + pd.Timedelta(days=1) - pd.Timedelta(seconds=1)
    horizon = min(horizon, pd.Timestamp(export_end))
    return (df["departed_at"] + pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)) <= horizon
EOF

"""How the aircraft has been behaving lately, rather than over the whole window."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

RECENT_FLIGHTS = 20
RECENT_DAYS = 14


def add(df, fit_flights, groundings, fit_end, portfolio):
    out = df.copy()
    end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end)
    since = end - pd.Timedelta(days=RECENT_DAYS)

    win_flights = fit_flights[(fit_flights["departed_at"] > since)
                              & (fit_flights["departed_at"] <= end)]
    win_groundings = groundings[(groundings["occurred_at"] > since)
                                & (groundings["occurred_at"] <= end)]

    counts = win_flights.groupby("tail_number")["flight_id"].size()
    grounded = win_groundings.groupby("tail_number").size().reindex(
        counts.index, fill_value=0)
    rate = (grounded / counts).astype("float64")

    last_flight = fit_flights.groupby("tail_number")["departed_at"].max()
    days_since = (end - last_flight).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    recent_delay = (fit_flights.sort_values("departed_at", kind="stable")
                    .groupby("tail_number")["departure_delay"]
                    .apply(lambda s: s.tail(RECENT_FLIGHTS).mean()))

    tail = out["tail_number"]
    out["f_recent_grounding_rate"] = tail.map(rate).fillna(
        float(portfolio["rate"])).astype("float64")
    out["f_days_since_prev_flight"] = tail.map(days_since).fillna(
        float(portfolio["gap"])).astype("float64")
    out["f_recent_dep_delay"] = tail.map(recent_delay).fillna(
        float(portfolio["dep_delay"])).astype("float64")
    return out

import sys, itertools; sys.path.insert(0,"src")
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from fleetrisk import (config, io_layer, pipeline, assemble, model,
                       calendar_feats, route_feats, fleet_profile, station_profile,
                       tail_history, station_history, recent, reliability, deviations,
                       observation, portfolio)

cfg = config.load("configs/reference.yaml")
flights = io_layer.read_flights(cfg)
groundings = io_layer.read_groundings(cfg)
fleet = io_layer.read_fleet(cfg)
stations = io_layer.read_stations(cfg)
WD = 3
export_end = flights["departed_at"].max()
period_start = flights["departed_at"].min()
fit_hi = pd.Timestamp(cfg["windows"]["fit"]["to"]) + pd.Timedelta(days=1) - pd.Timedelta(seconds=1)
ref = pd.read_csv("reference/scores_reference.csv")

def make_labels(mode):
    out = flights.copy()
    base = out[["tail_number","departed_at"]].copy(); base["_row"]=np.arange(len(base))
    m = base.merge(groundings[["tail_number","occurred_at"]], on="tail_number")
    d = (m["occurred_at"]-m["departed_at"]).dt.total_seconds()/86400.0
    if mode=="any_cc": hit=(d>=0)&(d<=WD)
    elif mode=="any_oc": hit=(d>0)&(d<=WD)
    elif mode=="any_co": hit=(d>=0)&(d<WD)
    elif mode=="any_oo": hit=(d>0)&(d<WD)
    elif mode.startswith("last"):
        out2 = out.sort_values(["tail_number","departed_at"],kind="stable")
        nxt = out2.groupby("tail_number")["departed_at"].shift(-1).reset_index(drop=True)
        nxt_map = nxt.to_dict()
        n = m["_row"].map(nxt_map)
        inner = (d>=0)&(d<=WD) if mode=="last_cc" else (d>0)&(d<=WD)
        hit = inner & (n.isna() | (n > m["occurred_at"]))
    lab = np.zeros(len(base),dtype=int); lab[m.loc[hit,"_row"]]=1
    out["label"]=lab
    return out.sort_values("flight_id",kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)

def run_variant(lab_mode, obs_mode, station_mode, recent_mode):
    labelled = make_labels(lab_mode)
    fit_raw = pipeline._window(labelled, cfg["windows"]["fit"])
    if obs_mode=="win":
        keep = (fit_raw["departed_at"]+pd.Timedelta(days=WD)) <= fit_hi
    elif obs_mode=="exp":
        keep = (fit_raw["departed_at"]+pd.Timedelta(days=WD)) <= export_end
    elif obs_mode=="none":
        keep = pd.Series(True, index=fit_raw.index)
    fit_raw = fit_raw[keep].reset_index(drop=True)
    score_raw = pipeline._window(labelled, cfg["windows"]["score"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    fit_end = fit_raw["departed_at"].max()
    levels = portfolio.levels(fit_raw, groundings, fit_end)
    hist = tail_history.history(fit_raw, groundings, fit_end)
    def prepare(frame):
        out = calendar_feats.add(frame, period_start)
        out = route_feats.add(out); out = fleet_profile.add(out, fleet); out = station_profile.add(out, stations)
        out = tail_history.add(out, hist, levels)
        out = station_history_v(out, fit_raw, groundings, fleet, fit_end, levels, station_mode)
        out = recent_v(out, fit_raw, groundings, fit_end, levels, recent_mode)
        return out
    fit_df = prepare(fit_raw); score_df = prepare(score_raw)
    base = levels["rate"]
    op = reliability.rate_table(fit_df, "operator", 50.0, base)
    fit_df = fit_df.assign(_route=reliability.route_key(fit_df))
    score_df = score_df.assign(_route=reliability.route_key(score_df))
    rt = reliability.rate_table(fit_df, "_route", 50.0, base)
    st = reliability.rate_table(fit_df, "origin", 50.0, base)
    fit_df = reliability.add(fit_df, op, rt, st); score_df = reliability.add(score_df, op, rt, st)
    fit_df = deviations.add(fit_df, levels); score_df = deviations.add(score_df, levels)
    mdl = model.RiskModel(5,200,0.08,6)
    mdl.fit(assemble.matrix(fit_df), fit_df["label"].to_numpy())
    risk = mdl.score(assemble.matrix(score_df))
    m = ref.merge(pd.DataFrame({"flight_id":score_df["flight_id"],"my":np.round(risk,6)}), on="flight_id")
    d = (m.risk_score-m.my).abs()
    return (d<=1e-6).mean(), float((m.risk_score-m.my).mean()), len(fit_raw), int(fit_raw.label.sum())

def station_history_v(df, fit_flights, groundings, fleet, fit_end, portfolio, mode):
    out = df.copy(); end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end)
    home = fleet.set_index("tail_number")["home_station"]
    departed = fit_flights.groupby("origin")["flight_id"].size()
    bf = fit_flights.assign(_b=fit_flights["tail_number"].map(home)).groupby("_b")["flight_id"].size()
    seen = groundings[groundings["occurred_at"]<=end].assign(_b=groundings["tail_number"].map(home))
    if mode=="flights":
        bg = seen.groupby("_b").size().reindex(bf.index, fill_value=0)
        rate = (bg/bf).astype(float)
    elif mode=="tails":
        ntail = fleet.groupby("home_station")["tail_number"].nunique()
        bg = seen.groupby("_b")["tail_number"].nunique()
        rate = (bg/ntail).astype(float)
    br = float(portfolio["rate"])
    out["f_origin_prior_flights"]=out["origin"].map(departed).fillna(0.).astype(float)
    out["f_origin_grounding_rate"]=out["origin"].map(rate).fillna(br).astype(float)
    out["f_dest_prior_flights"]=out["destination"].map(departed).fillna(0.).astype(float)
    out["f_dest_grounding_rate"]=out["destination"].map(rate).fillna(br).astype(float)
    return out

def recent_v(df, fit_flights, groundings, fit_end, portfolio, mode):
    out = df.copy(); end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end); since = end-pd.Timedelta(days=14)
    wf = fit_flights[(fit_flights["departed_at"]>since)&(fit_flights["departed_at"]<=end)]
    wg = groundings[(groundings["occurred_at"]>since)&(groundings["occurred_at"]<=end)]
    if mode=="win_all":
        cnt = wf.groupby("tail_number")["flight_id"].size()
        gr_ = wg.groupby("tail_number").size().reindex(cnt.index, fill_value=0)
        rate = (gr_/cnt).astype(float)
    elif mode=="win_zero":
        cnt = wf.groupby("tail_number")["flight_id"].size()
        gr_ = wg.groupby("tail_number").size()
        rate = (gr_/cnt).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
    elif mode=="all_flights":
        cnt = fit_flights.groupby("tail_number")["flight_id"].size()
        gr_ = wg.groupby("tail_number").size().reindex(cnt.index, fill_value=0)
        rate = (gr_/cnt).astype(float)
    lastf = fit_flights.groupby("tail_number")["departed_at"].max()
    ds = (end-lastf).dt.total_seconds()/86400.0
    rd = (fit_flights.sort_values("departed_at",kind="stable").groupby("tail_number")["departure_delay"]
          .apply(lambda s: s.tail(20).mean()))
    t = out["tail_number"]
    out["f_recent_grounding_rate"]=t.map(rate).fillna(float(portfolio["rate"])).astype(float)
    out["f_days_since_prev_flight"]=t.map(ds).fillna(float(portfolio["gap"])).astype(float)
    out["f_recent_dep_delay"]=t.map(rd).fillna(float(portfolio["dep_delay"])).astype(float)
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    combos = eval(sys.argv[1])
    for c in combos:
        agree, bias, n, lab = run_variant(*c)
        print(c, "agree=%.5f bias=%+.5f n=%d labels=%d" % (agree, bias, n, lab))

score_raw = pipeline._window(labelled, cfg["windows"]["score"]).reset_index(drop=True)
fit_end = fit_raw["departed_at"].max(); end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end)
levels = portfolio.levels(fit_raw, groundings, fit_end)
hist = tail_history.history(fit_raw, groundings, fit_end)

def station_v(df, mode):
    o = df.copy()
    departed = fit_raw.groupby("origin")["flight_id"].size()
    o["f_origin_prior_flights"]=o["origin"].map(departed).fillna(0.).astype(float)
    o["f_dest_prior_flights"]=o["destination"].map(departed).fillna(0.).astype(float)
    if mode=="base_flights":
        bf = fit_raw.assign(_b=fit_raw["tail_number"].map(home)).groupby("_b")["flight_id"].size()
        seen = groundings[groundings["occurred_at"]<=end].assign(_b=groundings["tail_number"].map(home))
        bg = seen.groupby("_b").size().reindex(bf.index, fill_value=0)
        rate = (bg/bf).astype(float)
    elif mode=="base_tails":
        nt = fleet.groupby("home_station")["tail_number"].nunique()
        seen = groundings[groundings["occurred_at"]<=end].assign(_b=groundings["tail_number"].map(home))
        bg = seen.groupby("_b")["tail_number"].nunique()
        rate = (bg/nt).astype(float)
    elif mode=="arrivals":
        arr = fit_raw.assign(dest=fit_raw["destination"])
        # rate over arrivals: groundings per flight arriving
        bf = fit_raw.groupby("destination")["flight_id"].size()
        seen = groundings[groundings["occurred_at"]<=end].assign(_b=groundings["tail_number"].map(home))
        bg = seen.groupby("_b").size().reindex(bf.index, fill_value=0)
        rate = (bg/bf).astype(float)
    br = float(levels["rate"])
    o["f_origin_grounding_rate"]=o["origin"].map(rate).fillna(br).astype(float)
    o["f_dest_grounding_rate"]=o["destination"].map(rate).fillna(br).astype(float)
    return o

        wg = groundings[(groundings["occurred_at"]>since)&(groundings["occurred_at"]<=end)]

        rd = rd_s.to_numpy()
        gg = {t: grp.to_numpy().astype("datetime64[ns]") for t, grp in groundings.groupby("tail_number")["occurred_at"]}
        grcnt = np.zeros(len(wf))

        key = pd.MultiIndex.from_arrays([o["tail_number"].to_numpy(), o["departed_at"].to_numpy()])

    o["f_days_since_prev_flight"]=t.map(ds).fillna(float(levels["gap"])).astype(float)

    dd = (mm.risk_score-mm.my).abs()
    print(tag, "agree=%.5f mean_my=%.6f" % ((dd<=1e-6).mean(), mm.my.mean()), flush=True)

firsts = np.flatnonzero(np.r_[True, tails[1:]!=tails[:-1]])
starts_all = np.repeat(firsts, np.diff(np.r_[firsts, len(tails)]))
gt = {t: grp.to_numpy() for t, grp in groundings.groupby("tail_number")["occurred_at"]}
tail_slice = {t:(firsts[i], firsts[i+1] if i+1<len(firsts) else len(tails)) for i,t in enumerate(tails[firsts])}
WIN = np.timedelta64(14,"D")
DAY = np.timedelta64(1,"D")

def feats(frame):
    o = frame.copy()
    n=len(o); T=o["tail_number"].to_numpy(); D=o["departed_at"].to_numpy()
    pf=np.zeros(n); pg=np.zeros(n); ds=np.full(n,np.nan); ten=np.full(n,np.nan)

    for i in range(n):
        sl = tail_slice.get(T[i])
        if sl is None: continue
        s,e = sl; now=D[i]
        # history up to and including current departure (count flights <= now)
        upto = np.searchsorted(dep[s:e], now, side="right") + s
        # prior flights strictly before: exclude flights at same timestamp? use < now
        prior = np.searchsorted(dep[s:e], now, side="left") + s
        pf[i] = prior - s
        a = gt.get(T[i])
        if a is not None and len(a):
            b = a[a <= now]
            pg[i]=len(b)

    o["f_origin_grounding_rate"]=o["origin"].map(rate).fillna(br).astype(float)
    o["f_dest_grounding_rate"]=o["destination"].map(rate).fillna(br).astype(float)
    return o

"""How the aircraft has been behaving lately, rather than over the whole window."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

RECENT_FLIGHTS = 20
RECENT_DAYS = 14


def add(df, fit_flights, groundings, fit_end, portfolio):
    out = df.copy()
    end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end)
    since = end - pd.Timedelta(days=RECENT_DAYS)

    win_flights = fit_flights[(fit_flights["departed_at"] > since)
                              & (fit_flights["departed_at"] <= end)]
    win_groundings = groundings[(groundings["occurred_at"] > since)
                                & (groundings["occurred_at"] <= end)]

    counts = win_flights.groupby("tail_number")["flight_id"].size()
    grounded = win_groundings.groupby("tail_number").size()
    rate = (grounded / counts).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    last_flight = fit_flights.groupby("tail_number")["departed_at"].max()
    days_since = (end - last_flight).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    recent_delay = (win_flights.sort_values("departed_at", kind="stable")
                    .groupby("tail_number")["departure_delay"]
                    .apply(lambda s: s.tail(RECENT_FLIGHTS).mean()))

    tail = out["tail_number"]
    out["f_recent_grounding_rate"] = tail.map(rate).fillna(
        float(portfolio["rate"])).astype("float64")
    out["f_days_since_prev_flight"] = tail.map(days_since).fillna(
        float(portfolio["gap"])).astype("float64")
    out["f_recent_dep_delay"] = tail.map(recent_delay).fillna(
        float(portfolio["dep_delay"])).astype("float64")
    return out

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from fleetrisk import (config, io_layer, pipeline, assemble, model, observation,
                       calendar_feats, route_feats, fleet_profile, station_profile,
                       tail_history, station_history, recent, reliability, deviations, portfolio)

cfg = config.load("configs/reference.yaml")
flights = io_layer.read_flights(cfg)
groundings = io_layer.read_groundings(cfg)
fleet = io_layer.read_fleet(cfg)
stations = io_layer.read_stations(cfg)
WD = cfg["labelling"]["window_days"]
period_start = flights["departed_at"].min()
export_end = flights["departed_at"].max()
fit_hi = pd.Timestamp(cfg["windows"]["fit"]["to"]) + pd.Timedelta(days=1) - pd.Timedelta(seconds=1)
ref = pd.read_csv("reference/scores_reference.csv")
home_station = fleet.set_index("tail_number")["home_station"]

def label_any(bound):
    out = flights.copy()
    base = out[["tail_number","departed_at"]].copy(); base["_row"]=np.arange(len(base))
    m = base.merge(groundings[["tail_number","occurred_at"]], on="tail_number")
    d = (m["occurred_at"]-m["departed_at"]).dt.total_seconds()/86400.0
    lo = d>=0 if bound[0]=="c" else d>0
    hi = d<=WD if bound[1]=="c" else d<WD
    hit = lo&hi
    lab=np.zeros(len(base),dtype=int); lab[m.loc[hit,"_row"]]=1
    out["label"]=lab
    return out.sort_values("flight_id",kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)

def run(lab_bound, obs_horizon, st_mode, recent_mode, prior_mode):
    labelled = label_any(lab_bound)
    fit_raw = pipeline._window(labelled, cfg["windows"]["fit"])
    horizon = fit_hi if obs_horizon=="fit" else export_end
    fit_raw = fit_raw[(fit_raw["departed_at"]+pd.Timedelta(days=WD))<=horizon].reset_index(drop=True)
    score_raw = pipeline._window(labelled, cfg["windows"]["score"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    fit_end = fit_raw["departed_at"].max()
    levels = dict(portfolio.levels(fit_raw, groundings, fit_end))
    if prior_mode=="label": levels["rate"] = float(fit_raw["label"].mean())
    base = float(levels["rate"])
    hist = tail_history.history(fit_raw, groundings, fit_end)

    def station_add(o):
        if st_mode=="base_flights":
            return station_history.add(o, fit_raw, groundings, fleet, fit_end, levels)
        o = o.copy(); end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end)
        departed = fit_raw.groupby("origin")["flight_id"].size()
        seen = groundings[groundings["occurred_at"]<=end]
        if st_mode=="home_tails":
            nt = fleet.groupby("home_station")["tail_number"].nunique()
            bg = seen.assign(_b=seen["tail_number"].map(home_station)).groupby("_b")["tail_number"].nunique()
            rate = (bg/nt).astype(float)
        elif st_mode=="dep_labels":
            bf = fit_raw.groupby("origin")["flight_id"].size()
            bg = fit_raw.groupby("origin")["label"].sum()
            rate = (bg/bf).astype(float)
        o["f_origin_prior_flights"]=o["origin"].map(departed).fillna(0.).astype(float)
        o["f_dest_prior_flights"]=o["destination"].map(departed).fillna(0.).astype(float)
        o["f_origin_grounding_rate"]=o["origin"].map(rate).fillna(base).astype(float)
        o["f_dest_grounding_rate"]=o["destination"].map(rate).fillna(base).astype(float)
        return o

    def recent_add(o):
        if recent_mode=="win_fill0":
            return recent.add(o, fit_raw, groundings, fit_end, levels)
        o = o.copy(); end = pd.Timestamp(fit_end); since = end-pd.Timedelta(days=14)
        lastf = fit_raw.groupby("tail_number")["departed_at"].max()
        ds=(end-lastf).dt.total_seconds()/86400.0
        rd=(fit_raw.sort_values("departed_at",kind="stable").groupby("tail_number")["departure_delay"]
            .apply(lambda s:s.tail(20).mean()))
        if recent_mode=="nan_nofly":
            wf=fit_raw[(fit_raw["departed_at"]>since)&(fit_raw["departed_at"]<=end)]
            wg=groundings[(groundings["occurred_at"]>since)&(groundings["occurred_at"]<=end)]
            cnt=wf.groupby("tail_number")["flight_id"].size()
            gr_=wg.groupby("tail_number").size()
            rate=(gr_/cnt).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
        elif recent_mode=="allflights":
            wg=groundings[(groundings["occurred_at"]>since)&(groundings["occurred_at"]<=end)]
            cnt=fit_raw.groupby("tail_number")["flight_id"].size()
            gr_=wg.groupby("tail_number").size().reindex(cnt.index, fill_value=0)
            rate=(gr_/cnt).astype(float)
        t=o["tail_number"]
        o["f_recent_grounding_rate"]=t.map(rate).fillna(base).astype(float)
        o["f_days_since_prev_flight"]=t.map(ds).fillna(float(levels["gap"])).astype(float)
        o["f_recent_dep_delay"]=t.map(rd).fillna(float(levels["dep_delay"])).astype(float)
        return o

    def prep(f):
        o=calendar_feats.add(f,period_start); o=route_feats.add(o)
        o=fleet_profile.add(o,fleet); o=station_profile.add(o,stations)
        o=tail_history.add(o,hist,levels)
        o=station_add(o); o=recent_add(o)
        return o
    fd=prep(fit_raw); sd=prep(score_raw)
    fd=fd.assign(_route=reliability.route_key(fd)); sd=sd.assign(_route=reliability.route_key(sd))
    op=reliability.rate_table(fd,"operator",50.0,base); rt=reliability.rate_table(fd,"_route",50.0,base)
    st=reliability.rate_table(fd,"origin",50.0,base)
    fd=reliability.add(fd,op,rt,st); sd=reliability.add(sd,op,rt,st)
    fd=deviations.add(fd,levels); sd=deviations.add(sd,levels)
    mdl=model.RiskModel(5,200,0.08,6)
    mdl.fit(assemble.matrix(fd),fd["label"].to_numpy())
    risk=mdl.score(assemble.matrix(sd))
    mm=ref.merge(pd.DataFrame({"flight_id":sd["flight_id"],"my":np.round(risk,6),
                               "watch_my":(risk>=0.08).astype(int)}),on="flight_id")

          (lab_bound,obs_horizon,st_mode,recent_mode,prior_mode,
           (dd<=1e-6).mean(),(dd<=1e-5).mean(),mm.my.mean(),mm.watch_my.sum()),flush=True)

if __name__=="__main__":
    for spec in eval(sys.argv[1]):
        run(*spec)
